details:
A straightforward suggestion, a developer SDK to allow the use of VRChat’s avatar system to be used within games outside of VRChat. Akin to the related VRM and Vroid SDKs, allowing the use of VRM and Vroid avatars respectively.

I can see a few benefits to providing developers a VRChat SDK for game development, namely advertising VRChat itself, to bring in more users, thus creators. Second, world creators of VRChat can expand their knowledge and capabilities more easily, creating new opportunities and training new potential developers to hire on the VRChat team! Lastly, and I’m sure is most important, another source of revenue as I’m sure it’s best to only provide the SDK to VRC+ users, or beyond that, make it available via purchase outside of VRC+

This idea personally excites me, despite the few VRM/Vroid games and mods available in the gaming space, but I believe, and have high hopes, that a VRChat SDK will create a more populous genre of self-insert games!
title: VRChat SDK for external games
